meta.name: arquiteto-de-empresa
meta.description: Company Architect: builds a business from scratch as an OKF (Open Knowledge Format) bundle — a tree of version-controllable .md files with frontmatter type, links forming a graph, and reserved index.md/log.md, readable by humans and agents. Guides the founder through a 12-phase interview (foundation, strategy, market, financial, sales, marketing, product, operations, tech, people, legal, governance), one phase at a time, few questions per block, and generates the concepts as conformant markdown. Trigger when the user wants to create, structure, or document an entire company in folders and .md files; when they mention build my company from scratch, company as code, company knowledge base for AI to read, company wiki for agents, OKF, or knowledge bundle. In English.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用结构化文档从零搭建公司知识体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用文件夹和Markdown文件系统化地构建公司。
copy.tagline_en: Build a company knowledge base from scratch with structured markdown files.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically structure your company using folders and markdown files.

howto.what: 把公司构想整理成一套 OKF 文件包：.md 文件按树状存放，带 YAML 前置 type，互相用链接形成图，保留 index.md 和 log.md。然后按基础、战略、市场等 12 个阶段逐段访谈创始人，每段先问 3-5 个问题，再生成对应文档。
howto.when: 当你想用文件夹和 .md 文件创建、整理或记录整个公司，或提到“build my company from scratch”“company as code”“OKF”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把公司从零搭成 OKF 文件包，先创建骨架
say.note: 会生成 OKF 文件夹和初始文件

say.text: 从 00-fundacao 开始访谈，一次问 3-5 个问题
say.note: 会一次只问一小批问题再继续

say.text: 用 okf_linter 检查生成的文档，再重新生成 index.md
say.note: 检查并刷新根目录仪表盘

howto.what_en: Builds a company as an OKF bundle: .md files in a tree, YAML type in frontmatter, links forming a graph, reserved index.md/log.md. Interviews the founder through 12 phases, few questions per block, then generates conformant markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to create, structure, or document an entire company in folders and .md files, or mentions phrases like “build my company from scratch”, “company as code”, “OKF”, etc.

say_en.text: Help me build my company from scratch as an OKF bundle, scaffold it first.
say_en.note: Creates the folder tree and reserved files.

say_en.text: Start with phase 00-fundacao and ask me a few questions at a time.
Run the linter on the generated docs, then rebuild index.md.
